settings.title: How we verify UK pharmacies
settings.text: Every pharmacy listed on MedEazy is checked against the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC) public register before it's included. We check it holds a valid registration, is authorised to dispense prescription medicines online and is in good standing. Listings are reviewed regularly, and no pharmacy pays for placement.

settings.title: About these prices
settings.text: Prices come straight from each pharmacy and are checked daily. Where a pharmacy offers a discount code, the discounted price is shown. Some pharmacies add a consultation fee, so always confirm the final price at checkout.

settings.heading: What is Wegovy?
settings.what: Wegovy is a prescription-only weekly injection containing semaglutide. It mimics GLP-1, a hormone that helps regulate appetite, so you feel fuller and eat less.
settings.who: Usually prescribed to adults with a BMI of 30 or above, or 27 or above with at least one weight-related condition. A clinical assessment and valid prescription are required.
settings.dosing: Treatment starts at 0.25mg weekly and steps up through 0.5mg, 1mg, 1.7mg and 2.4mg. Some patients move on to the 7.2mg dose if their prescriber advises it.

settings.question: Is Wegovy available on the NHS?
settings.answer: Wegovy is available on the NHS in limited circumstances. Private prescriptions are also available through registered UK pharmacies.

settings.question: Why do Wegovy prices differ between pharmacies?
settings.answer: Prices vary because of supplier agreements, dispensing fees and pharmacy overheads. The table shows each pharmacy's current price side by side.

settings.question: Are there extra costs beyond the medicine?
settings.answer: Some pharmacies charge a consultation or prescription fee. Always check the full cost at checkout before you order.

settings.question: Do I need a prescription for Wegovy injections?
settings.answer: Yes. Wegovy is prescription-only. You can get a prescription through a GPhC-registered online pharmacy via a digital consultation, with no GP referral needed.

settings.question: How much weight can I lose with Wegovy?
settings.answer: In clinical trials, adults lost around 15% of their body weight on average over 68 weeks, alongside diet and exercise. Individual results vary.

settings.question: Can I switch pharmacy to get a better price on Wegovy?
settings.answer: Yes. You can move to another GPhC-registered pharmacy at any time. The new pharmacy will check your prescription history before dispensing.

settings.question: How much is Wegovy per week?
settings.answer: Each month's supply is four weekly doses, so the weekly cost is a quarter of the monthly price. The per-week column in the price-by-dose table above shows today's figure for every dose, from {min:wegovy:0.25mg} a month on 0.25mg.

settings.question: Is cheaper Wegovy safe?
settings.answer: If the pharmacy is on the GPhC register, yes. It supplies the same licensed Novo Nordisk pens; the price difference is the pharmacy's margin and offers.
